model_choice: Exact MCLP formulation with binary x (site selection) and y (coverage indicator) variables. Fits backend: ~100 x + ~500 y = 600 variables, linear constraints only. Dense QUBO backend handles this easily.

lor_centers.meaning: LOR planning area centers in Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg

blocks.meaning: Blocks currently NOT covered by existing playgrounds (within 250m)

d_ij.meaning: Coverage indicator: 1 if block i is within 250m of LOR center j

k.meaning: Number of new playgrounds to select

prep.notes: Joined population tables via prep.match on schluessel. Filtered blocks and playgrounds to Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg (district code '02' or bezirkname). LOR centers derived by grouping blocks by schluessel prefix (first 6 chars = LOR ID) and computing centroids. is_uncovered computed via haversine distance to existing playgrounds. d_ij computed via haversine distance to LOR centers. k=3, radius=250m.
